==About==

A {{i|Candy Gang Candy Cane}} can be obtained by chance from the Store bought {{i|Mystery Weapon Chest}}. The Candy Gang Candy Cane counts as a Club type Weapon. CAUTION: A Candy Gang Candy Cane can actually be eaten! A Candy Gang Candy Cane can be hung on a wall.
